evals.prompt: I want to build a new web app. Scaffold it for me — call it `my-todo-app`, DB at `postgresql://postgres:password@localhost:5432/todos`, French as the second locale (`fr`). Proceed with the defaults and confirm the dependency list before installing.
evals.expected_output: A scaffolded Next.js 15 project named my-todo-app with all config files generated, drizzle schema created, better-auth wired up, sign-up form built with RHF+Zod+next-intl, unit test and Storybook story present, lint and tests passing.

assertions.name: drizzle-config-correct
assertions.description: drizzle.config.ts exists, references db/schema.ts as schema path, and sets dialect to postgresql

assertions.name: nextconfig-has-intl-plugin
assertions.description: next.config.ts imports and uses createNextIntlPlugin (or withNextIntl)

assertions.name: nextconfig-has-ssr-fix
assertions.description: next.config.ts has serverExternalPackages array that includes 'better-auth'

assertions.name: middleware-has-both-locales
assertions.description: src/middleware.ts (or i18n/routing.ts) defines both 'en' and 'fr' in the locales array

assertions.name: en-messages-has-signupform
assertions.description: messages/en.json contains a SignUpForm key with at least a 'submit' subkey

assertions.name: locale-messages-file-exists
assertions.description: messages/fr.json exists (the French locale file)

assertions.name: form-uses-translations
assertions.description: SignUpForm.tsx calls useTranslations and does NOT contain hardcoded English button or label text

assertions.name: form-uses-rhf-zod
assertions.description: SignUpForm.tsx imports useForm from react-hook-form and zodResolver from @hookform/resolvers/zod

assertions.name: test-uses-rtl
assertions.description: SignUpForm.test.tsx imports from @testing-library/react

assertions.name: test-has-three-cases
assertions.description: SignUpForm.test.tsx contains at least 3 it() or test() blocks

assertions.name: story-has-autodocs
assertions.description: SignUpForm.stories.tsx has tags: ['autodocs'] in the meta object

assertions.name: vitest-config-jsdom
assertions.description: vitest.config.ts sets environment to 'jsdom'

assertions.name: build-succeeded
assertions.description: build.txt does not contain lines with 'Build error', 'Type error', or 'Failed to compile'
